The goal states that "the cells are so big that I can not click on the cell I want" and asks to zoom out a little bit. Looking at the current screenshot, I can see that the spreadsheet is indeed displayed with very large cell sizes, making it difficult to interact with individual cells. The zoom level is currently at 10 pt as shown in the toolbar.

To address this issue, I need to zoom out the view to make the cells smaller and easier to interact with. There are several ways to do this in LibreOffice Calc:

1. Use the zoom slider at the bottom of the window
2. Use the View menu and select a zoom option
3. Use keyboard shortcuts like Ctrl+minus to decrease zoom

Looking at the current state, I notice that the zoom slider is located at the bottom right of the screen. The slider appears to be set at a high value currently. To zoom out, I would need to move the slider to the left.

The logical next action would be to click on the zoom slider at the bottom right of the screen and drag it slightly to the left to reduce the zoom level. This would make the cells smaller and easier to click on. The slider is located at the bottom right corner of the window, and I need to click and drag it slightly to the left to reduce the zoom level.

## Action:
Click on the zoom slider at the bottom right of the screen and drag it slightly to the left to reduce the zoom level.

## Code:
